body.ruleText:
rule dac_win_0117 {
  meta:
    author = "Detection Engineer"
    description = "Special privileges assigned to new logon (Tier-0) - Behavior: Special privileges assigned to new logon (Tier-0). Anchor is process+flag or event id+field after classic/XML coalesce. Not telemetry_validated. Security 4672 with 4624"
    severity = "Medium"
    rule_id = "DAC-WIN-0117"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1078.002"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "WINEVTLOG"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "4672"
    ($e.target.user.userid = /admin/ nocase or $e.principal.user.userid = /admin/ nocase or $e.target.user.userid = /domain admin/ nocase or $e.principal.user.userid = /domain admin/ nocase or $e.target.user.userid = "krbtgt" nocase or $e.principal.user.userid = "krbtgt" nocase or $e.target.user.attribute.permissions.name = /SeDebugPrivilege/ nocase)

  condition:
    $e
}
